answer: A payout is split and thus 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The velvet schedule is applied in ridge and glacier makes public each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4730 identities would post 3415 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
